text: 手机端（DSH 插件，web 与 mobile 浏览器）：让用户通过手机浏览器查看并操作电脑上运行的 DSH 会话。插件在 DSH 内启动网关并转发到本机网页服务，电脑端可生成二维码或链接供手机配对。用户可继续发送消息、查看任务状态并处理批准请求，也可选用 Cloudflare 隧道从外网连接，并配置任务完成或等待响应时的手机推送。适合需要离开电脑仍查看和继续 DSH 工作的人；首次外网访问会准备 cloudflared，推送需提供自己的服务地址。

Use DSH from a phone browser: pair by QR code, view desktop sessions, send messages and handle approvals. The plugin runs a local gateway and optional Cloudflare tunnel for remote access. Push alerts can report task completion or requests for input; outside access downloads cloudflared.

Can I pair my phone with a QR code and reply to DSH tasks remotely?
DSH Mobile 的功能「手机浏览器访问」：扫描电脑端生成的二维码后，手机浏览器通过网关打开同一 DSH 网页会话，可继续查看进度并发送消息。
DSH Mobile 的功能「外网隧道连接」：开启外网访问后插件准备 cloudflared 隧道；手机可通过隧道地址访问电脑上的网关。
DSH Mobile 的功能「任务状态推送」：配置推送地址后，可将任务完成或等待批准等状态通知到用户选择的推送服务。
DSH Mobile 的功能「配对设备管理」：电脑端面板可以重新生成配对码、移除指定手机或移除全部设备，网关会断开已移除设备。
DSH Mobile 使用外网功能时会建立 Cloudflare 隧道，并可能首次下载 cloudflared；网关会转发手机请求到本机 DSH 网页服务。见 lib/index.js:141-172。

简体中文 · English

**电脑上的 DSH 跑着任务，人出门了？手机扫一下，接着看、接着发消息。** > **一句话**：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，在手机浏览器里用电脑上的 DSH：扫码后看任务进度、回消息、点批准。走免费的 Cloudflare 隧道，在外面用流量也能连，不用装 App。 > > **什么时候用**：「出门了想在手机上看任务」「人不在电脑前也想回消息、点批准」。 > > **安装**：DSH「插件」页 →「添加插件」，填 `@orderg-x/dsh-mobile`（npm 包，连不上 npm 会自动换国内镜像），重启 DSH。macOS、Windows、Linux 都能用。

演示动画，内容是示例数据。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 有什么好：| | |
|---|---|
| 📱 **扫一下就能用** | 不用装 App、不用注册账号。手机相机扫码，手机浏览器里就是电脑上那个 DSH。 |
| 🔄 **同一批会话，实时同步** | 手机上发的消息，电脑上同时出现；模型干到哪，手机上实时看得到。 |
| 🌍 **在哪都能连** | 走 Cloudflare 免费隧道（HTTPS），在家在外都是同一个地址，出门用流量也能连。打开开关就自动准备好。 |
| 🔔 **跑完、要批准时推到手机** | 填一个 Bark / ntfy / Server酱 / 群机器人地址，任务跑完或等你点批准时手机响一下，点通知直接打开。 |
| 🔐 **只认你配过的手机** | 二维码只能用一次、10 分钟过期；每台手机一张凭证，随时移除，移除立刻断开。 |

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 安装：在 DSH「插件」页点「添加插件」，填包名：

```
@orderg-x/dsh-mobile
```

这是 npm 包：按包名装时，DSH 连不上 npm 官方源会自动改用国内镜像（npmmirror），不经过 GitHub。也可以填发布包地址 `https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile/releases/latest/download/dsh-mobile.tgz`，那样要能连上 GitHub。

装完**重启 DSH**。DSH「插件」页里显示为「手机端」。

**更新**：DSH 0.2.2 起，在「插件」页点开它，点「更新到 …」；更老的 DSH 先卸载，再按上面添加一次。新版发布后大约一天才装得到（DSH 装插件用的 pnpm 默认不装刚发布的版本）；急的话卸载后填发布包地址，不过这样装的以后不能点更新。
@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 安装：> **从 0.2.x 升级**：0.3.0 起包名改成 `@orderg-x/dsh-mobile`（npm 上的 `dsh-mobile` 是别人的包）。装上新版后，到「插件」页把旧的「dsh-mobile」移除，再重启 DSH。旧版还在时新版不会启动，只提示你移除旧版。设置都会保留；外网地址会换一个，手机重扫一次就好。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 怎么用：1. **电脑上**：点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或 DSH →「插件」→「手机端」），打开「允许手机访问」。
2. **手机上**：用相机扫出现的二维码，在家在外都能用。
3. **以后**：直接在手机上打开那个地址就行，建议「添加到主屏幕」（见常见问题）。DSH 重启后地址不变，不用重扫。
4. **想让手机响**：填一个推送地址，见下面的「手机推送」。

手机连着时，顶栏的手机按钮会亮绿点。扫不了码就点「复制链接」，发到手机上打开（10 分钟内有效、只能用一次）。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 手机推送（可选）：不想一直盯着手机？在「手机端」页的「推送到手机」里填一个地址，DSH 会在这两种时候推一条：

- **任务跑完**（跑了 30 秒以上的才推，来回几句的不打扰；出错停下也推）
- **等你批准 / 等你回答**（推完照常在 DSH 里弹卡片，推送不替你做决定）

填完点「发一条试试」，手机响了就好了。两种通知可以分别关。通知里只有会话标题和状态，不带对话内容。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 手机推送（可选）：| 用什么 | 怎么拿地址 |
|---|---|
| **Bark**（iPhone） | App Store 装 Bark，打开就有一行 `https://api.day.app/…`，整行复制过来 |
| **ntfy**（安卓 / iPhone） | 装 ntfy，订阅一个别人猜不到的主题名，填 `https://ntfy.sh/你的主题名` |
| **Server酱**（微信） | 在 sct.ftqq.com 用微信登录，复制 SendKey（`SCT…` 开头）填进来 |
| **飞书 / 企业微信 / 钉钉** | 在群里加一个「自定义机器人」，复制它的 Webhook 地址 |
| **Telegram** | `https://api.telegram.org/bot<机器人 token>/sendMessage?chat_id=<你的 chat id>` |

别的地址按通用 Webhook 处理：POST 一个 JSON（`title`、`body`、`url`）。
@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 手机推送（可选）：> 第一次打开外网时会自动下载 Cloudflare 的官方程序 cloudflared（约 20 MB），大约半分钟。这期间先显示一个临时的码，好了自动换掉。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 原理：

插件在 DSH 里起一个小网关（默认端口 18765），把手机的请求转给本机的 DSH 网页端。手机上跑的就是 DSH 官方网页界面，会话、设置都和电脑上一样。
技术细节

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 原理：- DSH 桌面版的网页端要登录：网关在 DSH 进程里用启动口令换一张登录 Cookie，替手机带上。这张 Cookie 不会发到手机上。
- 手机自己的凭证由网关发（HttpOnly、SameSite=Strict），盘上只存哈希。凭证只在配对时走的那条路上有效：Wi-Fi（明文）配的拿到外网隧道上用不了。
- 「手机端」的设置（开关、二维码、已配对的手机）只能在电脑上的 DSH 里管理，手机上读不到配对码。
- 局域网是明文 HTTP，浏览器少了一些「安全上下文」才有的接口，网关会给页面补上 DSH 需要的那个。
- 长连接空闲时，网关往手机方向发保活包，免得被隧道或运营商当成死连接掐断。
- 外网用 `cloudflared tunnel --url`（trycloudflare.com 快速隧道）：Cloudflare 把 HTTPS 流量转到你电脑上的网关，门禁照旧是网关的配对。
- 为了地址不变，DSH 退出时隧道程序留在后台（几乎不占资源），下次打开 DSH 接着用；关掉「允许手机访问」就会停掉它。

</details>

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 安全：扫过码的手机能让 DSH 在这台电脑上干活，跟你坐在电脑前一样。所以：

| 情况 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 二维码 | 只用自己的手机扫，别发给别人、别截图到群里 |
| 手机丢了 | 在「已配对的手机」里移除它，立刻断开 |
| 公共 Wi-Fi | 局域网模式是明文 HTTP，别用；用外网（HTTPS） |
| 不用的时候 | 关掉「允许手机访问」，网关就不再监听 |

数据都在 `~/.dsh/dsh-mobile/`：`state.json`（开关）、`devices.json`（已配对的手机，0600）、`mobile.log`、`tunnel.json` 和 `cloudflared.log`（外网隧道）、`bin/cloudflared`（下载的话）。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 常见问题：
要装 App 吗？ 不用装。用手机相机扫码，在手机浏览器里打开就是。
换了地方 / 电脑重启了，要重新扫吗？ DSH 重启不用。电脑重启、关掉「允许手机访问」、在 DSH 里停用或卸载这个插件之后，外网地址会换，要重新扫一次。
在中国大陆用流量快吗？ 够用。Cloudflare 的免费线路在大陆没有节点，请求会先绕到国外再回来，所以第一次打开要等一两秒；之后看任务、发消息都顺。信号差的时候会明显变慢。
别人捡到我的二维码能连吗？ 二维码只能用一次、10 分钟过期。已经被你扫过的码再扫就失效。真被别人先扫了，在「已配对的手机」里能看到，移除就行。

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 常见问题：
能像 App 一样从桌面打开吗？ 能。iPhone 用 Safari 打开那个地址，点「分享」→「添加到主屏幕」；安卓用 Chrome 打开，菜单里点「添加到主屏幕」或「安装应用」。之后从桌面图标打开，全屏、没有地址栏。
电脑睡着了还能连吗？ 不能。电脑睡眠或 DSH 关着时连不上。
@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · 反馈：遇到问题或想要新功能，[提一个 issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile/issues/new/choose)。报问题时写上 DSH 版本和插件版本，修起来最快。

简体中文 · English

**DSH is running a task on your computer and you have to leave? Scan once and keep watching and replying from your phone.**

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Introduction：> **What it is:** a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin to use the DSH on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, then follow tasks, reply and approve. It goes through a free Cloudflare tunnel, so it works on mobile data too, with no app to install.
>
> **Use it for:** "I'm heading out and want to keep an eye on the task", "reply or approve while I'm away from the computer".
>
> **Install:** on the DSH Plugins page, click Add plugin and enter `@orderg-x/dsh-mobile` (an npm package), then restart DSH. Works on macOS, Windows and Linux.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Why：| | |
|---|---|
| 📱 **Scan and go** | No app, no account. Point the phone camera at the QR code and the phone browser opens the same DSH as your computer. |
| 🔄 **Same sessions, live** | A message sent from the phone shows up on the computer at once; you see the model's progress on the phone as it happens. |
| 🌍 **Works anywhere** | Goes through a free Cloudflare tunnel (HTTPS): the same link at home or on mobile data outside. Set up automatically when you flip the switch. |
| 🔔 **Buzz when done or waiting** | Paste a Bark / ntfy / Telegram / chat-bot address and the phone buzzes when a task finishes or waits for your approval; tap the notification to open DSH. |
| 🔐 **Only your paired phones** | Each QR code works once and expires in 10 minutes; every phone gets its own credential, which you can revoke at any time. |

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Install：**Restart DSH** afterwards. It shows up as "Mobile" on the DSH Plugins page.

**Updating:** on DSH 0.2.2 or later, open it on the Plugins page and click "Update to …". On older DSH, uninstall it and add it again as above. A new version can be installed about a day after release, because the pnpm that DSH uses skips brand-new versions by default. To get it right away, uninstall it and add the release tarball instead (a tarball install can't use Update later).

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Install：> **Upgrading from 0.2.x:** from 0.3.0 the package is called `@orderg-x/dsh-mobile` (`dsh-mobile` on npm is someone else's package). After installing it, remove the old "dsh-mobile" on the Plugins page and restart DSH. While the old one is still installed the new one stays off and only asks you to remove it. Your settings are kept; the internet address changes, so scan the QR code once more on the phone.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Use：1. **On the computer**: click the phone button in the session header (or DSH → Plugins → Mobile) and turn on "Allow phone access".
2. **On the phone**: scan the QR code with the camera. It works at home and on the go.
3. **Later**: just open the same address on the phone (add it to the home screen, see the FAQ). It survives DSH restarts, so no rescan.
4. **Want the phone to buzz?** Add a push address, see "Phone notifications" below.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Use：While a phone is connected, the phone button in the header shows a green dot. If you cannot scan, use "Copy link" and open it on the phone (works once, within 10 minutes).

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Phone notifications (optional)：Tap "Send a test" and you're done once the phone buzzes. Each kind can be turned off. Notifications carry only the session title and status, never conversation content.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Phone notifications (optional)：| Service | Where to get the address |
|---|---|
| **Bark** (iPhone) | Install Bark from the App Store; copy the `https://api.day.app/…` line it shows |
| **ntfy** (Android / iPhone) | Install ntfy, subscribe to a hard-to-guess topic, paste `https://ntfy.sh/<topic>` |
| **ServerChan** (WeChat) | Sign in at sct.ftqq.com and paste your SendKey (starts with `SCT`) |
| **Feishu / Lark, WeCom, DingTalk** | Add a custom bot to a group and copy its webhook URL |
| **Telegram** | `https://api.telegram.org/bot<bot token>/sendMessage?chat_id=<your chat id>` |

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Phone notifications (optional)：Any other URL is treated as a generic webhook: it gets a JSON POST with `title`, `body` and `url`.

> The first time outside access is turned on, Cloudflare's official cloudflared (about 20 MB) is downloaded automatically, which takes about half a minute. Meanwhile a temporary code is shown and swapped when the tunnel is ready.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · How it works：

The plugin runs a small gateway inside DSH (port 18765 by default) and forwards the phone's requests to DSH's own web UI on the computer. The phone runs the official DSH web UI, so sessions and settings are exactly what you have on the computer.
Technical details

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · How it works：- DSH desktop's web UI requires a login. Inside the DSH process the gateway trades the launch token for a session cookie and attaches it for the phone; that cookie never reaches the phone.
- The phone's own credential is issued by the gateway (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict). Only its hash is stored on disk. A credential only works on the path it was paired on: one paired over Wi-Fi (plain HTTP) is refused on the outside tunnel.
- The Mobile settings (switch, QR code, paired phones) can only be managed in DSH on the computer; a phone cannot read the pairing code.
- The local network is plain HTTP, which lacks some "secure context" browser APIs; the gateway adds the one DSH needs.
- When a live connection is idle, the gateway sends keepalive pings toward the phone so tunnels and carriers don't drop it.
- Outside access uses `cloudflared tunnel --url` (a trycloudflare.com quick tunnel): Cloudflare forwards HTTPS traffic to the gateway on your computer, and the gateway's pairing still guards the door.
- To keep the address, the tunnel keeps running in the background when DSH quits (it uses almost nothing) and is picked up again next time; turning

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Security：A paired phone can make DSH work on this computer, just like sitting at it. So:

| Situation | What to do |
|---|---|
| QR codes | Scan only with your own phone; never send the code to anyone or post a screenshot |
| Lost phone | Remove it under "Paired phones"; it is disconnected at once |
| Public Wi-Fi | Same-Wi-Fi mode is plain HTTP; use the outside code (HTTPS) instead |
| Not using it | Turn off "Allow phone access"; the gateway stops listening |

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Security：Data lives in `~/.dsh/dsh-mobile/`: `state.json` (switches), `devices.json` (paired phones, 0600), `mobile.log`, `tunnel.json` and `cloudflared.log` (outside tunnel), and `bin/cloudflared` if downloaded.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · FAQ：
Do I need to install an app? No. Scan with the phone camera and it opens in the phone browser.
Do I have to scan again after a restart? Not after restarting DSH. After the computer restarts, phone access is turned off, or the plugin is disabled or uninstalled in DSH, the outside address changes and you scan once more.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · FAQ：
Is it fast enough on mobile data in mainland China? Yes for everyday use. Cloudflare's free network has no points of presence in mainland China, so requests travel abroad and back: the first load takes a second or two, after that watching tasks and sending messages feels fine. A weak signal makes it noticeably slower.
What if someone else gets my QR code?

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · FAQ：A code works once and expires in 10 minutes, so a code you already scanned is useless. If someone did scan it first, the phone shows up under "Paired phones"; remove it.
Can I open it like an app from the home screen? Yes. On iPhone open the address in Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen; on Android open it in Chrome and choose Add to Home screen or Install app. Launched from the icon it runs full screen without the address bar.

@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · FAQ：
Does it work while the computer sleeps? No. Nothing works while the computer sleeps or DSH is closed.
@orderg-x/dsh-mobile README · Feedback：Found a bug or want a feature? [Open an issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile/issues/new/choose). Including your DSH and plugin versions helps a lot.
